weeks.title: Week 1: SEC Forms 10-K & 10-Q
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: SEC Forms 10-K & 10-Q

Learning Objectives

  • Prepare 10-K financial statements and disclosures
  • Understand 10-Q requirements (condensed financials, interim reporting)
  • Apply Reg S-X (form and content) and Reg S-K (non-financial disclosures)

Key Topics

1. Annual report (10-K) requirements

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Annual report (10-K) requirements. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Annual report (10-K) requirements concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Annual report (10-K) requirements is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. Quarterly report (10-Q) requirements

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Quarterly report (10-Q) requirements concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Quarterly report (10-Q) requirements is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

3. Reg S-X and Reg S-K

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Reg S-X and Reg S-K. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Reg S-X and Reg S-K concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Reg S-X and Reg S-K is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: sec forms 10-k & 10-q concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Annual report (10-K) requirements for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Quarterly report (10-Q) requirements for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Reg S-X and Reg S-K for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 3: Segment Reporting (ASC 280)
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 3: Segment Reporting (ASC 280)
